evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I proceed confirming all the information here, do you have any concerns about the moving process or do you have any worries that you'd like to talk about?' — asked before substantive logistics probing. Full credit.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer clarified scope (partial move, furniture only) rather than raising a worry — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move takes less than this, then you will only be charged for how much time we used' present; missing rate/experience, self-prep tip, fair-check.

top_strength: Made the explicit close ask cleanly and handled the customer's 'not yet, let me talk to my roommate' response without any pressure.
coaching_note: Add the differentiators — none of damage coverage / meet-your-mover / on-time / communication landed anywhere in this call.
